title: fix(platform-objects): sys_session.revoke_reason description names admin_password_reset
body:
Fixes #23477

Clause-②: no

`sys_session.revoke_reason` is free text; its description is the field's only published vocabulary. It now names `admin_password_reset`, the value `plugin-auth/forced-reset-revocation.ts` (`FORCED_RESET_REVOKE_REASON`) writes on sessions an administrator's forced password reset revokes. Ruling (triage 6168824114): add the value with its cause and run `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; precedent #15784.

## Changes
- `sys-session.object.ts`: description lists `admin_password_reset` after `organization_membership_ended`; the in-code comment records it as the second authorization-event cause.
- `apps/translations/*.objects.generated.ts`: the generator rewrote `en`; the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES help strings are hand-written values, so I added the value there too, as #15784 did.
- New `plugin-auth/src/forced-reset-revoke-reason-vocabulary.test.ts`: asserts the description contains the producer's constant (no existing test pinned the list; plugin-auth already depends on platform-objects, the reverse would not be allowed).
- `.changeset/23477-revoke-reason-vocabulary.md`: patch for `@objectstack/platform-objects`, description text only.

Landing spot matches the claim's file surface; the test sits in plugin-auth, the producer side.

## Evidence (head after merging origin/main)
- `check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` exit 0; plain run: all bundles in sync (10 packages).
- plugin-auth new test 1/1; platform-objects full suite 70 files, 1091 tests; both packages' typecheck OK; `@objectstack/spec` `test:repo` 60 files, 1029 tests.
- dispatch-gates: 66 derived families, all run, all exit 0 except `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist for unrelated packages): NOT MEASURED, a description-only diff does not reach it.
- No accept/refuse change, so no consumer sweep beyond the above.

## Acceptance notes
Bundle folder is `apps/translations` (not `identity`); open PR #23469 also regenerates that folder, so the later lander re-runs the generator.
